CustomField.description: Comparison value. Type-checked against the field type at runtime. Not used for is_true, is_false, is_blank and is_not_blank. For in: several values separated by semicolons. For Date and Datetime fields also TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_N_DAYS:n or NEXT_N_DAYS:n, each meaning one day resolved in the running user's time zone.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The value to compare against. Leave blank for Is True, Is False, Is Blank and Is Not Blank. For In, separate values with semicolons (Billing;Account). Dates: 2026-01-31, TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_N_DAYS:30 or NEXT_N_DAYS:7.
CustomField.label: Value
